provenance: Seed: vibepm666/cursor-localization-zh publishes no LICENSE file. Its English-to-Chinese pairs are reused as translation memory with attribution; no upstream code, installer, binary, or Microsoft language pack is copied. Individual short UI strings carry weak copyright; the compilation was not copied verbatim (own schema, own filtering, own merge).
Own additions: sections 'cursor_3_27_补充' (85) and 'cursor_3_27_设置与自动化补充' (226) inside the same Core_Dictionary.json, plus 5 patterns (2 AI Stats readouts, 3 'N minutes/hours/days left' countdowns).

MIT: Uncle-Gao/Live-Translator-Hub dictionary.zh-CN.json and lsh2253823857/cursor-i18n-tool dict.js, both MIT licensed, pinned to the commits listed below. The JS file is parsed as text with a small safe tokenizer, never executed.

Priority on conflicting translations: own > MIT > upstream seed. When two MIT dictionaries disagree, the one listed first in this manifest wins. Every conflict is recorded in conflicts.json with the rejected values.
Filtering drops untranslated pairs (Chinese == English), values without any Chinese character, URLs, file names, and regex/code noise.

The build is deterministic: entries are sorted by key, lists are ordered explicitly, no wall-clock timestamp is used (generatedAt is fixed), and the MIT sources are pinned to the commits below. Rebuilding from the same inputs produces identical bytes.
Rebuild with: python3 tools/build_dictionary.py (sources overridable via CURSOR_ZH_UPSTREAM_DIR and the per-source path env vars).
